name: Miss Finger
role: Medora school teacher, of South Heart
mentions: School was opened Monday morning in the church building, Miss Finger of South Heart being teacher. The number of scholars was not as large as was expected, but by next Monday it is hoped that all children of a proper age will be in attend…
Miss Finger of South Heart, attended the Christmas hop, and is now a guest of Mrs. E. G. Paddock.
